description: A server-side route handler for a Tasks List page in a SvelteKit project, interacting with a Django REST API backend. It handles loading task data, applying filters, and various CRUD operations for tasks, including additional actions like moving tasks within a kanban view and changing task status. The file manages API calls, data transformation between backend and frontend formats, and exports server actions for task creation, update, completion, reopening, deletion, and repositioning.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes tasks data, handles filters, pagination, and view modes. It fetches related entities like users, accounts, contacts, and tags, and transforms backend API responses into frontend structures.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Creates a new task by collecting form data, transforming it to match Django backend field names, and making a POST API request.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by taskId, sending patch data to the backend.

methods.name: actions.complete
methods.description: Marks a task as completed by updating its status.

methods.name: actions.reopen
methods.description: Reopens a task by setting its status back to 'New'.

methods.name: actions.moveTask
methods.description: Repositions a task within the task list or kanban view, optionally changing its status or stage, using move-specific API endpoint.
